gates.description: Hara owns a headless workspace.* state, event, view and effect contract.
gates.evidence: hara-lang/hara#383 introduced workspace.*, #384 synchronized runtime mirrors and conformance paths, and #385 restored the complete release/archive validation. The merged revision is pinned.

gates.description: Hara web-* packages remain product-neutral and include a neutral add-on lifecycle.
gates.evidence: hara-lang/hara-ui#9 merged at dd871a20e110f1775d3b6584d037fb48862ca7fc with green package tests and is pinned.

gates.description: Hodos Web connects HAL-shaped Workspace component models to trusted packaged UI factories.
gates.evidence: greenways-ai/hodos#24 established the trusted component and area hosts, #25 added prepared Preview documents, and #26 began the Editor component boundary. The latest merged revision is pinned.

gates.description: Playground mounts its Preview through Hodos Dev while retaining Hara preview isolation.
gates.evidence: hara-lang/hara-playground#29 mounted Preview through Hodos Dev. #30 pinned the merged Hodos adapter, scoped audio observation away from component-internal DOM writes, and passed both Node CI and the Chromium/Supersonic smoke.

gates.description: Existing Hodos Worlds source, renderer and viewer contracts remain compatible during the broader reorganisation.
gates.evidence: The pinned Hodos revision keeps Core independent and retains replaceable source, renderer and viewer packages while adding Dev components above them.

gates.description: Greenways OS retains installation, keyring, consent and privileged capability authority outside Hodos.
gates.evidence: The pinned Greenways OS baseline verifies installed app identity and keeps raw key material out of application surfaces.

gates.description: A Hodos keyring connector requests typed operations without receiving credentials or private keys.
Supersonic is an optional Hodos Audio connector rather than an inseparable neutral Hara runtime feature.
gates.evidence: Tracked by greenways-ai/hodos#22 and the later Hara runtime profile split.
